page.overview:
What is Pheromosa?

thumb|left|Concept artwork of Pheromosa. Pheromosa is a tall , thin, white and gold, highly-feminine, anthropomorphic cockroach-like Pokémon with a long white membrane resembling long hair. It has a long antennae that somewhat resemble the whiskers of fish. Its eyes are oval-shaped with purple irises and blue pupils. It has golden pads on its joints and yellow feet that resemble high heels. Its body is segmented, and it bears a resemblance to a fashion model wearing a tight-fitting outfit and a short skirt.

Pheromosa is violent, malevolent, and evil, like all of its UB counterparts. As seen in Beauty Is Only Crystal Deep!, Pheromosa is a clean freak and refuses to touch anything it considers dirty, and is capable of taking advantage of Pokémon who has become infatuated with its beauty to do its bidding and empower itself.

Pheromosa is able to twitch its limbs at a speed of an estimated 120+ miles per hour, appearing blurry to the human eye. It uses powerful kicks to swiftly defeat it's enemies. It also produces a pheromone that causes those nearby to become awestruck at its presence. It lures in its prey in this intentionally malevolent and cruel, sadistic manner.

Pheromosa is based on a with humanoid traits. It particularly resembles the molted shell of a cockroach, which are usually white or transparent. Being a counterpart to Buzzwole, it may play off of the theme of the two, with Pheromosa resembling the Flight response and usually relying on speed.
